changeSet.sql: DELETE c FROM animal_colors c JOIN species s ON s.id = c.specie_id WHERE ((s.name = 'Canino' AND c.name IN ('Carey', 'Calico', 'Carey Diluido', 'Colorpoint', 'Esmoquin', 'Humo', 'Sombreado', 'Chinchilla')) OR (s.name = 'Felino' AND c.name IN ('Leonado', 'Trigueño', 'Higado', 'Ruano', 'Arlequin', 'Merle', 'Merle Azul', 'Merle Rojo', 'Sable', 'Negro y Fuego', 'Manto Negro'))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM animals a WHERE a.color_id = c.id);
